Scope actions and resources to the minimum required (least privilege).

Remove 'hostNetwork: true' unless building a node-level agent that genuinely needs it.
Sharing host PID/IPC lets the container inspect and signal other processes on the node.
Container 'payments-api' may run as root (runAsUser is 0 (root)).
Running as root increases the impact of a container escape or application compromise.
Powerful capabilities can be abused to escalate to the host.
Drop all capabilities ('capabilities.drop: [ALL]') and add back only what is required.

If the service is internal, use type ClusterIP, or add the cloud provider's internal

aws_security_group.db allows 0.0.0.0/0 ingress to sensitive port(s): 5432 (PostgreSQL).
Exposing admin/database ports to the whole internet invites brute-force and
Restrict 'cidr_blocks' to known office/VPC ranges, or front the service with a bastion/VPN.

Set 'publicly_accessible = false' and place the database in private subnets.
A public ACL exposes bucket contents to anyone on the internet.
Use 'private' ACL and grant access via IAM/bucket policy. Enable an
A mutable tag like 'latest' makes rollouts non-reproducible and can pull an unreviewed
image, including one with new vulnerabilities.
Pin images to an immutable tag or digest (e.g. 'app:1.4.2' or 'app@sha256:...').
Without probes, Kubernetes cannot detect unhealthy pods or delay traffic until the app
is ready, causing failed requests during rollout.
Define livenessProbe and readinessProbe for each container.
Container 'payments-api' is missing: memory limit, cpu request/limit, memory request.
Without a memory limit a single pod can consume all node memory and trigger OOM kills on
Set 'resources.requests' and 'resources.limits' for cpu and memory.
A single replica means any node failure, eviction or rollout causes downtime for this
Run at least 2 replicas and add a PodDisruptionBudget for critical services.
Container 'payments-api' does not set allowPrivilegeEscalation: false.
A process could gain more privileges than its parent (e.g. via setuid binaries).
Ingress 'payments-ingress' does not define a 'tls' block.
Traffic may be served over plaintext HTTP, exposing credentials and data in transit.
Add a 'spec.tls' section and terminate TLS (e.g. via cert-manager).
Data at rest is unencrypted, failing most compliance baselines.
Set 'storage_encrypted = true' (note: enabling it may require a replacement).
A compromised container can use the mounted token to call the Kubernetes API.
Set 'automountServiceAccountToken: false' unless the pod needs API access.
